name: @orbb/fhir
description: Deterministic internal-to-FHIR R4 boundary mapper for ORBB (M7-A A46): pure functions mapping ORBB domain objects (PersonId, Observation, measurement task/attempt sets, HealthIntent, EvidenceObject records, AccessGrant, Provenance) to FHIR R4 JSON for Patient/Observation/DiagnosticReport/Condition/DocumentReference/Consent/Provenance, with domain-separated deterministic resource ids, canonical (sorted-key, byte-stable) serialization, privacy-first defaults (identifier-only Patient unless a deliberate DemographicPort is supplied), fail-closed typed mapping errors on malformed input or unknown vocabulary, and the stable-provenance linkage invariant. One direction only: ORBB in, FHIR out (ingestion is a future-milestone handoff). Zero runtime dependencies (type-only @orbb/domain and @orbb/measurement imports + node:crypto).
